title: Some Supabase customers are publicly exposing reams of people's data to the web | TechCrunch
summary: Thousands of databases hosted by development platform Supabase are exposing people’s sensitive information to the public web, new security research by cybersecurity firm UpGuard has found. Zack Whittaker is the security editor at TechCrunch.
